preserved_semantics.load_session: Cline advertises session/load at the baseline; Swallowtail does not expose or call it.
preserved_semantics.identity: Swallowtail does not expose Cline's provider request identity headers or Cline session identifiers.
preserved_semantics.provider_category: The provider config option category changes from model to _provider at 3.0.74. Swallowtail matches the model option by id model, so that row is not the model observation.
